title: Mean, median and standard deviation
prompt:
Daily hours studied by 7 students: 12, 15, 9, 18, 21, 15, 10.
- Find the mean.
- Find the median.
- Find the population standard deviation.

title: Statistics of quiz scores
prompt:
Quiz scores out of 10: 6, 8, 7, 9, 10, 8, 5, 7.
- Find the mean.
- Find the median.
- Find the population standard deviation.

title: Quartiles
prompt:
Ordered data (N = 11): 23, 27, 31, 35, 38, 40, 42, 45, 49, 52, 55.
Use position r(N + 1)/4.
- Find Q1.
- Find Q3.
- Find the interquartile range.

title: Percentile rank
prompt:
Twelve exam scores: 45, 52, 58, 61, 64, 67, 70, 73, 78, 84, 88, 91.
Use percentile rank = (number of scores below x) ÷ N × 100.
- How many scores are below 73?
- Find the percentile rank of 73.

title: Class rank from percentile
prompt: A student is at the 84th percentile in a class of 250. Use class rank = N − (p/100)N. What is the student's rank?

title: Probability with two dice
prompt:
Two fair dice are rolled.
- How many outcomes are there?
- Find P(sum = 8).
- Find P(sum is at least 10).

title: Probability from a deck
prompt:
One card is drawn from a standard 52-card deck.
- P(a heart)?
- P(a king or a heart)?
- P(not a face card)? (face cards: J, Q, K)

title: Independent events
prompt:
A coin is tossed and a die is rolled.
- P(head and a 6)?
- P(tail and an even number)?
- P(head or a 6)?

title: Mean of grouped data
prompt:
Scores grouped by class midpoint (frequency): 55 (4), 65 (10), 75 (14), 85 (8), 95 (4).
- Find N.
- Find Σfx.
- Find the mean.

title: z-score
prompt:
Exam scores have mean 65 and standard deviation 8.
- Find the z-score of a score of 77.
- Find the score that has z = −1.5.
